requirements: The system shall allow users to create and manage their accounts, including profile information and order history.
The system shall provide a user-friendly interface for customers to browse and search for restaurants and their menus.
The system shall enable customers to place orders, including selecting items, specifying special instructions, and applying promotions or discounts.
The system shall facilitate real-time order tracking, allowing customers to monitor the status of their orders from preparation to delivery.
The system shall support multiple payment methods, including credit cards, online payment services, and cash on delivery.
The system shall generate and send order confirmations, receipts, and delivery updates to customers via email and SMS.
The system shall allow restaurant partners to manage their menus, including adding, editing, and removing items, as well as setting prices and availability.
The system shall provide restaurant partners with a dashboard to track orders, sales, and customer feedback.
The system shall integrate with third-party services for delivery logistics, including routing optimization and driver management.
The system shall maintain a rating and review system, allowing customers to evaluate restaurants and drivers.
The system shall ensure the security and confidentiality of customer data, including payment information and personal details.
The system shall be scalable to handle a large volume of concurrent users and orders, with a minimum uptime of 99.9%.
The system shall provide an average response time of less than 2 seconds for all user interactions.
The system shall be compatible with a range of devices and browsers, including desktops, laptops, mobile phones, and tablets.
The system shall adhere to relevant regulatory requirements, including GDPR and PCI-DSS.
The system shall provide backup and recovery mechanisms to ensure business continuity in case of system failures or data loss.
The system shall support multiple languages and currencies to cater to a diverse user base.
The system shall be designed for maintainability, with modular code and automated testing to facilitate updates and bug fixes.
The system shall provide real-time analytics and reporting to help stakeholders monitor performance and make data-driven decisions.
The system shall ensure accessibility for users with disabilities, following WCAG guidelines and best practices.

risk_report.risk: Inaccurate or incomplete requirements may lead to project scope creep or misalignment with stakeholder expectations.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct thorough stakeholder interviews and workshops to validate requirements.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate architecture may result in scalability and performance issues, leading to system downtime or poor user experience.
risk_report.mitigation: Engage experienced architects to design a scalable and flexible system architecture.

risk_report.risk: Poorly designed user interface may lead to low user adoption and high bounce rates due to frustration or confusion.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct user experience (UX) research and testing to inform intuitive and user-friendly interface design.

risk_report.risk: Inefficient database schema may cause data inconsistencies, slow query performance, or data loss.
risk_report.mitigation: Collaborate with experienced database administrators to design a normalized and optimized database schema.

risk_report.risk: Insecure authentication mechanisms may expose user credentials or allow unauthorized access to the system.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement industry-standard authentication protocols, such as OAuth or OpenID Connect, and follow best practices for password storage and transmission.

risk_report.risk: Inaccurate or outdated restaurant data may lead to incorrect ordering or customer dissatisfaction.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop a data validation and update process to ensure accuracy and timeliness of restaurant information.

risk_report.risk: Inefficient order processing may result in delayed or lost orders, leading to customer dissatisfaction and revenue loss.
risk_report.mitigation: Design and implement a robust order management system with automated workflows and real-time tracking.

risk_report.risk: Insecure payment processing may expose sensitive customer financial information or result in transaction errors.
risk_report.mitigation: Integrate a reputable and secure payment gateway, such as Stripe or PayPal, and follow PCI-DSS compliance guidelines.

risk_report.risk: Inaccurate or delayed order tracking may lead to customer frustration or confusion about order status.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop a real-time tracking system with automated updates and notifications to keep customers informed about order status.

risk_report.risk: Biased or fake reviews may undermine the credibility of the rating system and impact customer trust.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement a moderation process and algorithms to detect and prevent fake or biased reviews.

risk_report.risk: Incompatible or poorly integrated third-party services may cause system downtime, errors, or data inconsistencies.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct thorough testing and validation of third-party service integrations to ensure compatibility and reliability.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate security measures may expose the system to cyber threats, data breaches, or other security vulnerabilities.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement a comprehensive security framework, including firewalls, encryption, and access controls, and conduct regular security audits and penetration testing.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate scalability and performance optimization may result in system downtime, slow response times, or poor user experience during peak usage.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct load testing and performance optimization to ensure the system can handle increased traffic and usage.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate backup and recovery mechanisms may result in data loss or system downtime in the event of a disaster or system failure.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop a comprehensive backup and disaster recovery plan, including regular backups, redundancy, and failover procedures.

risk_report.risk: Inaccessible features may exclude or frustrate users with disabilities, leading to negative user experience and potential legal issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct accessibility testing and implement features that comply with accessibility standards, such as WCAG 2.1.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate unit testing may lead to undetected bugs or defects, causing system failures or errors.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop a comprehensive unit testing strategy, including automated testing and code reviews.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate integration testing may result in compatibility issues or errors between system components.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct thorough integration testing to ensure compatibility and functionality between system components.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate system testing may lead to undetected system-level defects or issues, causing system failures or errors.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop a comprehensive system testing strategy, including end-to-end testing and user acceptance testing.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate user acceptance testing may result in a system that does not meet user requirements or expectations.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct thorough user acceptance testing with real users to validate system functionality and usability.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate deployment processes may result in system downtime, errors, or data inconsistencies during deployment.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop a comprehensive deployment plan, including automated deployment scripts, rollback procedures, and monitoring.

risk_report.risk: Inadequate monitoring and maintenance may lead to system downtime, errors, or security vulnerabilities due to neglected updates or issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop a comprehensive monitoring and maintenance plan, including regular updates, backups, and security audits.

risk_report.risk: Requirements may be incomplete or ambiguous, leading to scope creep or rework.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct thorough stakeholder interviews and validate requirements with prototypes or use cases.

risk_report.stage: Define system architecture and high-level design
risk_report.risk: Architecture decisions may not scale or align with future needs, causing technical debt.
risk_report.mitigation: Evaluate trade-offs and document assumptions; review with senior architects and stakeholders.

risk_report.stage: Design database schema and data models
risk_report.risk: Poor schema design may lead to performance bottlenecks or data integrity issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Normalize where necessary, index critical fields, and validate with sample queries.

risk_report.risk: Prototypes may not reflect user expectations, requiring costly redesigns later.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct user testing early and iterate based on feedback before finalizing designs.

risk_report.stage: Set up development environment and tools
risk_report.risk: Inconsistent or misconfigured environments may cause integration issues or delays.
risk_report.mitigation: Use infrastructure-as-code and standardized tooling with version control.

risk_report.risk: Core services may have undetected flaws that propagate to dependent components.
risk_report.mitigation: Enforce peer reviews, modular design, and early integration testing.

risk_report.risk: Frontend logic may not handle edge cases, leading to poor user experience or errors.
risk_report.mitigation: Write component-level tests and validate behavior with user acceptance criteria.

risk_report.risk: Mismatched APIs or data contracts may cause runtime failures or security issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Define and version API contracts early; use contract testing or mock servers.

risk_report.stage: Write unit tests for backend services
risk_report.risk: Insufficient test coverage may allow bugs to reach production undetected.
risk_report.mitigation: Enforce coverage thresholds and test critical paths and error conditions.

risk_report.stage: Write unit tests for frontend components
risk_report.risk: Frontend tests may be flaky or incomplete, reducing confidence in releases.
risk_report.mitigation: Use reliable testing frameworks and mock external dependencies consistently.

risk_report.risk: Integration issues may go undetected until late in the cycle, increasing fix costs.
risk_report.mitigation: Test end-to-end flows early and automate regression tests for critical paths.

risk_report.stage: Conduct system testing and bug fixes
risk_report.risk: System-level defects may be missed, leading to poor performance or outages in production.
risk_report.mitigation: Use load testing, security scanning, and staged rollouts to validate stability.

risk_report.risk: Staging may not mirror production, causing deployment issues or hidden bugs.
risk_report.mitigation: Keep staging configuration identical to production and automate environment provisioning.

risk_report.risk: Deployment errors may cause downtime or data loss during critical operations.
risk_report.mitigation: Use blue-green deployments, automated rollback mechanisms, and pre-deployment checklists.

risk_report.risk: Undetected issues may impact users before being noticed, damaging trust or revenue.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement real-time monitoring, alerting, and automated validation checks post-deployment.
